shots.visual_event: Meera uses Tick’s thirteenth gear and Maya’s handbell to open a stable mirror between Platform 13 and the Conductor’s carriage.
Maya sees the cracked mask. Elias removes it completely, revealing the older face of the teenager who saved her in 1976.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “You missed fifty birthdays.” Elias: “I counted every one.”

shots.visual_event: Elias explains that he became Conductor after the previous keeper vanished, using the role to slow Nila’s releases.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “I enforced the rule because a bad lock was all we had.”

shots.visual_event: Maya places her palm on the mirror; Elias aligns his palm without touching, mirroring Episode 1 without an exchange.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “Then help us build a better one.”

shots.visual_event: Elias gives Arin the master ticket punch and names him Passenger One by choice, not ownership.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “A rule born from consent can be rewritten by consent.”

shots.visual_event: The engine tears open. Nila sits in the driver’s position as all twelve doors unlock toward the city.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “You had a century. I’m opening everything.”

end_card.text: ARC II COMPLETE — THE TRAIN HAS NO CONDUCTOR
